customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash); one profile per natural person known to the servicer

full_name.meaning: legal full name exactly as on the identity document and the loan or estate papers

profile_type.meaning: the capacity in which the servicer knows this person: a borrower on the note, a non-borrowing spouse named at closing (eligible or ineligible under the closing certification), a confirmed successor in interest (heir, estate representative, trustee) of a deceased borrower, or a third party the borrower authorized in writing

linked_customer_id.meaning: for a non-borrowing spouse, successor in interest or authorized third party, the customer id of the borrower whose loan they are linked to; empty for a borrower

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth on the identity document; the basis for every age test

email.meaning: email address on file, lower case

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the Social Security number on file

property_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mortgaged property (for a successor or third party, the ZIP code of the deceased or represented borrower's property)

mailing_address.meaning: mailing address on file for notices, exactly as recorded

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the servicer opened this customer profile

hecm_loan_id.meaning: primary id of the HECM loan record

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower on the note (foreign key -> customers)

co_borrower_customer_id.meaning: second borrower on the note (foreign key -> customers); empty when there is a single borrower

nbs_customer_id.meaning: non-borrowing spouse named at closing (foreign key -> customers); empty when there is none

variant_name.meaning: the payout plan currently in effect, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the loan (basis: lifecycle.states of the HECM charter)

loan_number.meaning: 10-digit servicing loan number printed on every statement

fha_case_number.meaning: FHA case number assigned to the loan

closing_date.meaning: date the borrower signed the loan documents (consummation); the anchor of the rescission period and of the first-year disbursement period

funding_date.meaning: date the loan funded after the rescission period; empty while in the rescission period or if rescinded

rate_type.meaning: interest rate type of the note

margin_pct.meaning: lender margin added to the index for an adjustable loan; 0.000 for a fixed-rate loan

note_rate_pct.meaning: current annual note interest rate in effect

initial_note_rate_pct.meaning: note rate in effect at closing; the base for lifetime rate caps

rate_change_date.meaning: date the current note rate took effect

expected_rate_pct.meaning: expected rate locked at closing, used to set the principal limit and tenure or term payments

max_claim_amount.meaning: maximum claim amount: lesser of the appraised value at closing and the FHA limit in force

initial_disbursement_limit.meaning: maximum total that may be disbursed at closing and during the first-year period, fixed at closing

mandatory_obligations_amount.meaning: mandatory obligations paid at closing (upfront MIP, closing costs, liens paid off, required repair administration)

closing_disbursement_amount.meaning: total disbursed at closing including mandatory obligations and any cash to the borrower

principal_balance.meaning: current outstanding loan balance; identically the sum of the loan_balance account deltas

available_line.meaning: current net principal limit available for draws; identically the sum of the line_of_credit account deltas; 0.00 where none

scheduled_payment_amount.meaning: monthly scheduled payment in effect; 0.00 when the plan has none

scheduled_payment_term_months.meaning: number of monthly payments for a term-based plan counted from its first scheduled payment; 0 for other plans

scheduled_payment_start_period.meaning: first month in which the current scheduled payments are disbursed; empty when the plan has none

servicing_fee_option.meaning: how servicing is compensated: built into the rate (no monthly fee) or a monthly fee drawn from a servicing fee set-aside

property_type.meaning: FHA property type of the mortgaged home

youngest_borrower_age_at_closing.meaning: age of the youngest borrower on the closing date

due_and_payable_date.meaning: date the loan entered due-and-payable status; empty otherwise

deferral_start_date.meaning: date the deferral period began for an eligible non-borrowing spouse; empty otherwise

terminated_date.meaning: date the loan was rescinded, paid in full or claim-terminated; empty while open

hecm_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the HECM ledger transaction

hecm_loan_id.meaning: loan the transaction posts to (foreign key -> hecm_loans)

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower of the loan (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: transaction family, verbatim from the HECM charter event types

amount.meaning: transaction amount; the family's declared account and direction give the sign of its effect

effective_date.meaning: date the transaction takes effect on the loan

accrual_period.meaning: month the accrual, fee, growth credit or scheduled payment belongs to; empty for transactions that are not monthly

hecm_request_id.meaning: borrower request that authorized the transaction (foreign key -> hecm_requests); empty for system postings

disbursement_method.meaning: how funds were sent to the borrower; not_applicable for non-cash postings

advance_type.meaning: what an advance posting or its reversal paid for; not_applicable for other families

allocation_bucket.meaning: balance component a prepayment portion is applied to; not_applicable for other families

restores_line.meaning: for a prepayment portion, whether it is credited back to the available line; false for other families

rate_applied_pct.meaning: annual rate used for an interest, MIP or line growth accrual; empty for other families

source_txn_ref.meaning: reference of the originating transaction: for a posting fired by another ledger entry, that entry's id; for a return, reversal or restore, the id of the original transaction it offsets; empty otherwise

hecm_request_id.meaning: primary id of the borrower request

customer_id.meaning: borrower who submitted the request (foreign key -> customers)

hecm_loan_id.meaning: loan the request concerns (foreign key -> hecm_loans)

requested_amount.meaning: amount requested for a draw; 0.00 for other request types

requested_plan.meaning: payout plan requested in a plan change; not_applicable for other request types

requested_term_months.meaning: term requested for a term-based plan change; 0 otherwise

disbursement_method.meaning: disbursement method chosen for a draw; not_applicable otherwise

request_channel.meaning: channel through which the request was submitted

request_date.meaning: date the complete request was received

decline_reason.meaning: controlled reason a request was declined; not_applicable unless declined

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: moment the request record was created

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: primary id of the Summit loan record

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

co_borrower_customer_id.meaning: second borrower (foreign key -> customers); empty when none

variant_name.meaning: Summit plan, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the loan (basis: lifecycle.states of the Summit charter)

closing_date.meaning: consummation date; anchor of the rescission and draw periods

funding_date.meaning: date the loan funded; empty before or if rescinded

initial_note_rate_pct.meaning: note rate at closing; the base for the lifetime rate cap

margin_pct.meaning: margin added to the index for an adjustable plan; 0.000 for a fixed plan

rate_change_date.meaning: date the current note rate took effect

principal_balance.meaning: outstanding balance; identically the sum of the summit_balance account deltas

available_line.meaning: undrawn line; identically the sum of the summit_line account deltas; 0.00 where none

draw_period_end_date.meaning: last day draws may be made; empty where the plan has no line

property_state.meaning: state where the property is located

due_and_payable_date.meaning: date the loan became due and payable; empty otherwise

terminated_date.meaning: date the loan was rescinded, paid in full or liquidated; empty while open

jumbo_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the Summit ledger transaction

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: loan the transaction posts to (foreign key -> jumbo_loans)

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: transaction family, verbatim from the Summit charter event types

amount.meaning: transaction amount; the family's account direction gives the sign

accrual_period.meaning: month of an interest accrual or growth credit; empty otherwise

draw_reference.meaning: confirmation number of the borrower's draw request, exactly as issued; empty for other families

disbursement_method.meaning: how a draw was sent; not_applicable otherwise

advance_type.meaning: what an advance posting paid for; not_applicable for other families

allocation_bucket.meaning: component a prepayment portion is applied to; not_applicable otherwise

restores_line.meaning: for a prepayment portion, whether it is credited back to the line; false otherwise

source_txn_ref.meaning: originating or offset transaction: the draw, reserve disbursement, plan advance, inspection or prepayment portion this entry follows from; empty otherwise

setaside_id.meaning: primary id of the set-aside record

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower of the loan (foreign key -> customers)

hecm_loan_id.meaning: HECM loan the set-aside belongs to (foreign key -> hecm_loans); empty for a Summit reserve

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: Summit loan the reserve belongs to (foreign key -> jumbo_loans); empty for a HECM set-aside

loan_program.meaning: loan program of the loan the set-aside belongs to

variant_name.meaning: set-aside plan, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the set-aside (basis: lifecycle.states of the set-aside charter)

established_date.meaning: date the set-aside was established (the loan closing date)

closed_date.meaning: date the set-aside was cancelled or closed; empty while active or depleted

setaside_balance.meaning: undisbursed balance; identically the sum of the setaside_funds account deltas

annual_property_tax.meaning: annual property tax on file for the property; 0.00 where the set-aside pays none

annual_hazard_premium.meaning: annual hazard insurance premium on file; 0.00 where the set-aside pays none

annual_flood_premium.meaning: annual flood insurance premium on file; 0.00 where none or not payable

semiannual_installment_amount.meaning: fixed semi-annual borrower installment of a Partially Funded LESA; 0.00 otherwise

repair_estimate_amount.meaning: accepted repair estimate behind a Repair Set-Aside; 0.00 otherwise

setaside_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the set-aside ledger transaction

setaside_id.meaning: set-aside the transaction posts to (foreign key -> setaside_accounts)

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: transaction family, verbatim from the set-aside charter event types

loan_program.meaning: loan program of the set-aside's loan, copied from the set-aside record

amount.meaning: transaction amount; the family's account direction gives the sign

accrual_period.meaning: month a growth credit or fee draw belongs to, or month of a semi-annual installment; empty otherwise

setaside_request_id.meaning: bill or borrower request the disbursement pays (foreign key -> setaside_requests); empty otherwise

coverage_type.meaning: insurance coverage an insurance disbursement pays; not_applicable otherwise

repair_draw_number.meaning: sequence number of a repair disbursement on the set-aside; 0 otherwise

release_reason.meaning: why an unused balance was released; not_applicable otherwise

rate_applied_pct.meaning: annual growth rate applied to a growth credit; empty otherwise

source_txn_ref.meaning: originating transaction: the HECM servicing fee a fee draw pays, or the original disbursement or fee draw a refund credit offsets; empty otherwise

setaside_request_id.meaning: primary id of the bill or borrower request

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

setaside_id.meaning: set-aside the bill or request is addressed to (foreign key -> setaside_accounts)

request_type.meaning: a payable bill received from a taxing authority or insurer, or a borrower request

bill_reference.meaning: parcel-and-installment number of a tax bill, policy-and-term number of an insurance bill, or contractor invoice number of a repair draw, exactly as printed

billed_amount.meaning: amount due on the bill or invoiced for the repair draw; 0.00 for a cancellation

due_date.meaning: delinquency date of a tax bill or due date of a premium; empty for borrower requests

inspection_pct_complete.meaning: percent of the repair work the inspection report found complete; 0.00 for other request types

inspection_reference.meaning: inspection report number supporting a repair draw, exactly as printed; empty otherwise

request_date.meaning: date the bill or request was received

decline_reason.meaning: controlled reason a bill or request was declined; not_applicable unless declined

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

propcharge_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the property charge repayment arrangement

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

hecm_loan_id.meaning: HECM loan the advances were made on (foreign key -> hecm_loans); empty for a Summit loan

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: Summit loan the advances were made on (foreign key -> jumbo_loans); empty for a HECM loan

variant_name.meaning: repayment arrangement, written as the official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the arrangement (basis: lifecycle.states of the property charge charter)

opened_date.meaning: date of the first unrepaid advance that opened the record

arrearage_balance.meaning: unrepaid advances; identically the sum of the arrearage account deltas

term_months.meaning: number of installments in effect; 0 where none

first_installment_date.meaning: due date of the first installment; empty where none

agreement_issued_date.meaning: date the agreement was issued for signature; empty before

signed_date.meaning: date every borrower had signed; empty before

default_date.meaning: date the arrangement defaulted; empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the arrangement completed or was referred; empty while open

propcharge_plan_id.meaning: arrangement the transaction posts to (foreign key -> propcharge_plans)

loan_program.meaning: loan program, copied from the arrangement

amount.meaning: transaction amount; the family's account direction gives the sign; 0.00 for documentary entries

charge_type.meaning: property charge an advance paid; not_applicable otherwise

bill_reference.meaning: parcel-and-installment or policy-and-term number of the bill an advance paid, exactly as printed; empty otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation number of a repayment, exactly as issued; empty otherwise

installment_number.meaning: installment a missed-installment entry concerns; 0 otherwise

review_year.meaning: year of an at-risk extension review; empty otherwise

review_outcome.meaning: result of an at-risk review; not_applicable otherwise

residency_profile_id.meaning: primary id of the occupancy certification profile

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower of the loan (foreign key -> customers)

hecm_loan_id.meaning: HECM loan the profile monitors (foreign key -> hecm_loans); empty for a Summit loan

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: Summit loan the profile monitors (foreign key -> jumbo_loans); empty for a HECM loan

loan_program.meaning: loan program of the monitored loan

nbs_customer_id.meaning: eligible non-borrowing spouse who certifies (foreign key -> customers); empty when none

representative_customer_id.meaning: trustee, attorney-in-fact or guardian who signs (foreign key -> customers); empty when none

variant_name.meaning: certification plan, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the profile (basis: lifecycle.states of the residency charter)

enrolled_date.meaning: date the profile was enrolled (the loan's funding date)

certification_due_date.meaning: due date of the open certification cycle

last_certified_date.meaning: date the most recent cycle was completed; empty before the first

absence_start_date.meaning: facility admission date of an ongoing health-care absence; empty otherwise

nonoccupancy_basis.meaning: why non-occupancy was confirmed; not_applicable otherwise

nonoccupancy_date.meaning: date non-occupancy was confirmed; empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the profile closed; empty while open

residency_event_id.meaning: primary id of the residency event

residency_profile_id.meaning: profile the event belongs to (foreign key -> residency_profiles)

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the residency charter event types

loan_program.meaning: loan program of the monitored loan, copied from the profile

certification_year.meaning: certification cycle the event belongs to: the calendar year of the cycle's due date; empty for absence check-ins

notice_type.meaning: kind of notice mailed; not_applicable for other families

certifier_customer_id.meaning: person whose signed certification was recorded (foreign key -> customers); empty for other families

certification_method.meaning: how a certification was given; not_applicable for other families

residency_submission_id.meaning: submission the event records (foreign key -> residency_submissions); empty when none

inspection_reason.meaning: why an occupancy inspection was ordered; not_applicable for other families

inspection_fee.meaning: fee of an ordered inspection; 0.00 for other families

inspection_outcome.meaning: result returned by the inspector; not_applicable for other families

checkin_sequence.meaning: sequence number of a health-care absence check-in within the current absence; 0 for other families

source_event_ref.meaning: the inspection order an inspection result answers; empty otherwise

subject_customer_id.meaning: person the submission is about: the signer of a certification, the absent or returning borrower, the borrower who moved or died (foreign key -> customers)

event_date.meaning: date stated and documented in the submission: signature date of a certification, facility admission date, return date, move-out date or date of death

document_reference.meaning: reference printed on the supporting document (facility letter, death certificate number, attestation or order number), exactly as printed; empty when none

reject_reason.meaning: controlled reason a submission was rejected; not_applicable unless rejected

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

maturity_case_id.meaning: primary id of the maturity case

hecm_loan_id.meaning: HECM loan the case concerns (foreign key -> hecm_loans); empty for a Summit loan

jumbo_loan_id.meaning: Summit loan the case concerns (foreign key -> jumbo_loans); empty for a HECM loan

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the case (basis: lifecycle.states of the maturity charter)

event_date.meaning: date of the maturity event itself per the plan's event_date_basis (date of death, deed recording date, and so on)

opened_date.meaning: date the case was opened (the date the servicer learned of the event)

hud_request_date.meaning: date HUD approval was requested; empty when not requested

due_and_payable_date.meaning: date the loan was called due; empty before

response_deadline.meaning: last day for the borrower or successors to state how the loan will be resolved; empty before the loan is called due

resolution_deadline.meaning: current last day to resolve the loan before foreclosure referral, including granted extensions; empty before the loan is called due

appraised_value.meaning: as-is appraised value from the most recent case appraisal; 0.00 before one is recorded

successor_customer_id.meaning: confirmed successor in interest or borrower acting on the case (foreign key -> customers); empty until recorded

successor_intent.meaning: resolution intent declared within the response window, or no_response once the window passed without one; not_applicable before the loan is called due

referral_date.meaning: date the case was referred to foreclosure counsel; empty otherwise

resolution_type.meaning: how the case ended; not_applicable while open

closed_date.meaning: date the case was cured or resolved; empty while open

maturity_event_id.meaning: primary id of the case event

maturity_case_id.meaning: case the event belongs to (foreign key -> maturity_cases)

event_type.meaning: event family, verbatim from the maturity charter event types

hud_action.meaning: HUD step recorded; not_applicable for other families

notice_type.meaning: notice sent; not_applicable for other families

recipient_customer_id.meaning: person a notice was addressed to (foreign key -> customers); empty for other families

extension_number.meaning: which extension a HUD extension step or a granted extension is; 0 otherwise

extended_deadline.meaning: resolution deadline after a granted extension; empty for other families

maturity_request_id.meaning: request the event acts on (foreign key -> maturity_requests); empty when none

stated_intent.meaning: intent declared in an intent_declaration; not_applicable otherwise

evidence_type.meaning: kind of document supporting the request

evidence_reference.meaning: reference printed on the supporting document (listing agreement number, commitment letter number, recording number, inspection report number), exactly as printed; empty when none

evidence_date.meaning: date on the supporting document (listing date, commitment date, recording date, inspection date); empty when none

decline_reason.meaning: controlled reason a request was declined; not_applicable unless declined

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

borrower_customer_id.meaning: borrower of record on the loan (foreign key -> customers)
